_comment: Candidate locators, tried in order until one is visible. The login_* entries were checked against the live login page on 2026-11-26. The dashboard/export entries were verified on 2026-11-26. If Sellerboard changes the page, run 'python run.py --inspect' and put the new locator at the TOP of the list. Any Playwright selector works: css, xpath=, text=, role=.
_note_maintenance: Seen 2026-11-26 on the login page: a 'System maintenance' box saying 'We are updating sellerboard with new features ... try again in 5-10 minutes'.
_note_dashboard: Verified 2026-11-26: the Products table export button appears once the dashboard has loaded.
_note_export: Verified 2026-11-26: the Products table's download icon is <button ng-click="entriesExport($event, 'xls')">. It builds the export server-side behind a progress popup, then downloads an Excel file. The other entries are fallbacks.
_note_progress: Verified 2026-11-26 from a stuck export: Sellerboard's 'preparing export' popup is div#entriesExportModal. While it is open the file is still being built, so the export must not be clicked again (the popup blocks the button anyway).
